sections.heading: Gifts of Nature (p.12)
sections.body:
By the end, students will: recite the poem 'Golden Sun' aloud with actions, and name the gifts we get from the sun, reading words with correct long and short vowels.
textbook_ref: Golden Sun · p.13-14

sections.heading: Beauty of Nature (p.13)
sections.body:
By the end, students will: read and recite the poem 'Caterpillar' for meaning, and read words with silent letters — the silent 'b' in lamb, climb, thumb.
textbook_ref: Caterpillar · p.14-16

sections.body:
Time: 23-40 min
pages: 5-6
words: sun
words: earth
words: bird
words: plant
words: ray
concept: Gifts of the sun: light · life · warmth
page: Golden Sun, page 14
opening_line: Brown and furry, Caterpillar in a hurry
silent_letter_words: lamb
silent_letter_words: climb
silent_letter_words: thumb
page: Caterpillar, pages 15-16

a.label: Grade 3
a.body: Ask: 'When the sun comes out in the morning, what changes around us?' Let 3-4 pupils share. Write one word from each answer on the board. Open page 13, point to sunrise picture.

b.label: Grade 4
b.body: Ask: 'Have you ever seen a caterpillar on a leaf, or a butterfly near flowers? What did you notice?' Let 3-4 pupils share. Open page 14, point to life-cycle picture.

items.label: grade_3_teacher
items.body: Recite 'Golden Sun' one line at a time with actions. Say 'sun' (short u) and 'shine' (long i). Class claps vowels. Ask: 'Suraj hamein kaun se tohfe deta hai?' Expected: light, life, warmth.

items.label: grade_4_works_on_own
items.body: Look at page 15. Read 'Caterpillar' quietly. Copy words lamb, climb, thumb. Think about caterpillar's colour.

items.label: grade_4_teacher
items.body: Read 'Caterpillar' aloud. Write lamb, climb, thumb — explain silent b. Ask: 'What is the colour of a caterpillar?' Expected: Brown.

items.label: grade_3_works_on_own
items.body: Read the 5 board-prep words aloud in a whisper. Say 'sun' and 'shine' with partner. Whisper your favourite gift of the sun.

items.label: grade_3_struggler
items.body: Teacher recites one line, student repeats just the last word with the action.

items.label: grade_4_struggler
items.body: Teacher points to lamb and says it; student repeats aloud — no writing needed.

items.label: Time: min 11-16
items.body:
teacher_with: Grade 3 — recite 'Golden Sun' with actions, then post-read Q
grade_4_independent: Copy silent-letter words lamb, climb, thumb from Board Prep

items.label: Time: min 16-18
items.body:
activity: A Grade 4 buddy reads one line of 'Caterpillar' to a Grade 3 buddy, who claps the rhythm. Swap after 1 min.
transition_cue: Clap twice, say 'G3, apni jagah pakadiye. G4, apni jagah tasveer dekhein.'

items.label: Time: min 18-23
items.body:
teacher_with: Grade 4 — silent-letter words + echo the 'Caterpillar' poem
grade_3_independent: Describe the sunset picture in one sentence
correction_tip: If a pair says the b in lamb, gently correct: 'b khamosh hai — laam.'
monitor_role: Pick one Grade 3 student as Monitor (rotates weekly). During Rotation B: keep Grade 3 on task, point to picture if a child forgets, quietly say 'shabash' when they finish.

items.label: timing
items.body: Min 23-25: assign tasks · Min 25-27: G3 first · Min 27-30: G4 · Min 30-36: rotate every 90 sec

items.label: need_help
items.body: Copy 3 words from the board: light, life, warmth.

items.label: standard
items.body: 1. Write 3 gifts from the sun. 2. Copy line from 'Golden Sun' and underline the long-vowel word: 'Shine down on me today!'

items.label: challenge
items.body: Write one sentence about the sun using the word 'because'.

items.label: extra_support
items.body: Point to the sun on the board as you name each gift in Urdu · draw the sun and 3 things · circle the correct gift.

items.label: need_help
items.body: Copy 3 words and circle the silent letter: lamb, climb, thumb.

items.label: standard
items.body: 1. Write 4 words with silent letter and circle it. 2. Copy one line from 'Caterpillar' and read aloud to partner.

items.label: challenge
items.body: Find and write 2 more words with a silent letter from your own reading.

items.label: extra_support
items.body: Circle the silent letter in 3 words teacher writes · trace lamb, climb, thumb from dotted template.

items.label: finished_early
items.body: Did you like the poem? Why? Write one sentence.

a.label: Grade 3
a.body:
recap_grade_3: We recited 'Golden Sun'. The sun gives us light, life and warmth. We noticed the long-vowel word 'shine'.
exit_ticket_grade_3: (a) 'Suraj hamein do tohfe kaun se deta hai?' — Expected: any two of light, life, warmth.
(b) Underline the long-vowel word in: 'Shine down on me today' — Expected: shine.
grade_3: Draw the sun and 2 gifts it gives us. Label each in English AND Urdu.

b.label: Grade 4
b.body:
recap_grade_4: We read the poem 'Caterpillar' and learned silent letters: the b in lamb, climb and thumb is silent.
exit_ticket_grade_4: (a) 'Caterpillar nazm ki aik line sunayen — caterpillar kaisa hai?' — Expected: Brown.
(b) Read aloud: lamb, climb, thumb. Kaun sa letter khamosh hai? — Expected: The letter b.
grade_4: Find and write 2 more words that have a silent letter.

sections.heading: extra_support
sections.body: Circle the correct answer on the board · point to matching picture · trace on dotted line · draw the answer.
